E-Shram Card — Registration & Benefits

• Last updated: 2026-09-15 · 3 min read
Share:
In simple words:

E-Shram Card unorganised sector ke workers ke liye ek national database registration card hai. E-Shram portal par register karne wale workers ko government schemes ka direct benefit, accident insurance cover, aur future social security benefits mil sakte hain.

S
Samjho Content Team ✓

Trusted and policy experts simplifying MSME, tax, and compliance for India. Verified by Chartered Accountants.

Simple explanation

E-Shram (Electronic Shram) ek initiative hai Ministry of Labour & Employment ka, jiske under India ke unorganised sector ke workers — jaise construction workers, street vendors, domestic workers, farm labourers, plumbers, electricians — ek national database mein register hote hain.

Registration free hai aur online (eshram.gov.in) ya nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) par ho sakta hai. Register karne par aapko ek E-Shram Card (Universal Account Number — UAN) milta hai jo 12-digit ka hota hai.

E-Shram Card holders ko abhi tak ke main benefits mein shaamil hai: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY) ke under ₹2 lakh accident insurance cover (premium government bharta hai), aur government ki doosri schemes — jaise PM Shram Yogi Maandhan, Ayushman Bharat — ka seedha access.

Registration ke liye aapke paas Aadhaar number, Aadhaar-linked mobile number, aur bank account hona zaroori hai. Age criteria 16-59 years hai aur aap income tax payer nahi hone chahiye. Unorganised sector mein kaam karne wala koi bhi worker eligible hai.

Why does it matter?

India mein 90%+ workforce unorganised sector mein kaam karti hai — jahan na PF hai, na pension, na formal insurance. E-Shram registration in workers ko government ke social security net se jodta hai. Future mein jab bhi koi new scheme aaye unorganised workers ke liye, E-Shram registered workers ko pehle priority milegi.

Example

In numbers

Ek construction worker jo daily ₹500 kamata hai, E-Shram register karne ke baad PMSBY ke under ₹2 lakh accident cover paata hai — bina koi premium diye. Agar kaam ke dauran accident hota hai, toh uski family ko ₹2 lakh mil sakte hain. Saath hi, agar government koi new scheme launch karti hai — jaise monthly pension ya health cover — toh woh automatically eligible hoga kyunki woh national database mein registered hai.

Important things to know

  • E-Shram registration completely free hai — kisi agent ko paise na dein.
  • UAN (Universal Account Number) 12-digit unique number hai jo aapko E-Shram Card ke saath milta hai.
  • Accident insurance cover ₹2 lakh hai PMSBY ke under — premium government bharta hai.
  • Eligibility: 16-59 years age, unorganised sector worker, not an income tax payer.
  • Registration ke liye chahiye: Aadhaar number, Aadhaar-linked mobile, bank account details.
  • Online registration eshram.gov.in par ya CSC centre par ho sakta hai.
  • E-Shram Card se PM Shram Yogi Maandhan (₹3,000/month pension at 60 years) mein bhi jud sakte hain.
  • Registration ek baar karni hai — lifetime validity hai, koi annual renewal nahi.

Common mistakes

  • Agent ko paise dena registration ke liye — E-Shram registration 100% free hai, sirf official portal ya CSC use karein.
  • Galat occupation category select karna — registration ke waqt apna sahi kaam choose karein, baad mein change karna mushkil hota hai.
  • Aadhaar-linked mobile na hona — OTP aapke Aadhaar-linked mobile par hi aayega, bina uske registration nahi hoga.
  • Bank account details galat dena — koi bhi benefit seedha bank mein aata hai, galat details se payment fail ho jaayegi.
  • E-Shram Card ko sirf 'insurance card' samajhna — yeh ek national database registration hai, future schemes ka access bhi milta hai.

Frequently asked questions

E-Shram Card ke liye online registration kaise karein?

eshram.gov.in par jaayein, 'Register on eShram' button click karein. Apna Aadhaar number enter karein, OTP verify karein (Aadhaar-linked mobile par). Personal details, occupation, bank details bharein aur submit karein. Aapko turant UAN mil jaayega aur E-Shram Card download ho jaayega.

E-Shram Card ke kya benefits hain?

Main benefits: ₹2 lakh accident insurance cover (PMSBY), government social security schemes ka access (PM Shram Yogi Maandhan, Ayushman Bharat etc.), aur future schemes mein automatic eligibility. National database mein registration hone se government aap tak schemes pahuncha sakti hai.

E-Shram Card kaun banwa sakta hai?

Koi bhi worker jo 16-59 years ka hai, unorganised sector mein kaam karta hai (construction, domestic work, street vending, farming labour, plumbing, electrical, weaving etc.), income tax payer nahi hai, aur jiske paas Aadhaar + Aadhaar-linked mobile + bank account hai — woh E-Shram Card banwa sakta hai.

E-Shram Card mein details kaise update karein?

eshram.gov.in par 'Update / Edit' section mein jaayein. Apna UAN ya Aadhaar number enter karein, OTP verify karein. Aap address, mobile number, occupation aur bank details update kar sakte hain. Kuch changes ke liye nearest CSC bhi ja sakte hain.

Agar mera Aadhaar mobile link nahi hai toh kya karoon?

Pehle apna mobile number Aadhaar se link karwa lein — nearest Aadhaar Enrolment Centre par jaayein. Bina Aadhaar-linked mobile ke E-Shram registration nahi ho sakta kyunki OTP verification zaroori hai.

E-Shram Card se pension kaise milegi?

E-Shram registration ke baad aap PM Shram Yogi Maandhan Yojana mein enroll kar sakte hain. Isme aapko monthly ₹55-₹200 (age ke basis par) contribute karna hota hai, aur 60 years ki age ke baad aapko ₹3,000 per month pension milegi. Enrollment CSC centres ya online ho sakta hai.
